svg.title: Thank you and questions
svg.desc: Closing slide with a thank-you heading, questions, a linked repository QR code, and a colorful Bloch sphere with a state vector. Qubits can be represented by vectors. Gates apply unitary transformations. Measurement picks one basis state at random; algorithms make the desired outcome likely.
